source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the addition reactions of benzene (PDF 70-71).

blocks.text: Sakht halaat mein benzene addition karta hai. Hydrogenation ring ke carbons par hydrogen jorti hai; mukammal hydrogenation se cyclohexane banta hai, jo mufeed solvent aur doosre chemicals ka khaam maal hai: C6H6 + 3H2 -> C6H12. Methylbenzene isi tarah methylcyclohexane deta hai.

Yeh reactions benzene ring ki delocalisation khatam kar dete hain, kyunke pi electrons naye hydrogen atoms se bond banane mein use hote hain. Reactions kul mila kar exothermic hain, kyunke naye C-H bonds mazboot hain, lekin in ki activation rukawat oonchi hai. In mein wahi bareek pisa nickel catalyst use hota hai jo alkenes ki hydrogenation mein, milte julte darja hararat (taqreeban 150 C) par lekin zyada pressure par.
Chlorine aur bromine bhi isi tarah jurte hain. Catalyst ke baghair UV roshni aur garmi mukammal addition ke liye kaafi hain: C6H6 + 3Cl2 -> C6H6Cl6 (1,2,3,4,5,6-hexachlorocyclohexane).

blocks.alt: Oopar: benzene + 3H2, nickel par taqreeban 150 C aur zyada pressure par, cyclohexane deta; methylbenzene + 3H2 methylcyclohexane deta. Neeche: benzene + 3Cl2, UV roshni aur garmi mein, 1,2,3,4,5,6-hexachlorocyclohexane deta, chhe carbon ka saturated halqa jis ke har carbon par aik Cl aur aik H.
blocks.caption: Benzene par hydrogen aur chlorine ka addition (kitab ke mua'adlon ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har addition mein teen molecules ring par jurte hain, aur delocalised pi nizam khatam ho jata hai: product chhe rukni saturated halqa hai. Hydrogen ko nickel catalyst aur pressure chahiye; chlorine ko UV roshni chahiye, jo chlorine radicals banati hai.

blocks.prompt: Quick Check 20.8 mein bane trialkylbenzene (nishan 3-ethyl-5-propyltoluene) ki tezaabi KMnO4 ya K2Cr2O7 se oxidation ka product batayein.
blocks.explanation: Har side chain ka benzylic hydrogen hai, is liye teenon COOH groups mein oxidise hoti hain: benzene-1,3,5-tricarboxylic acid.

blocks.prompt: AlBr3 ki maujoodgi mein chlorobenzene mein bromine milane ka product batayein.
blocks.explanation: Ortho aur para positions par ring substitution (Cl ortho-para director hai): zyada tar 1-bromo-4-chlorobenzene aur kuch 1-bromo-2-chlorobenzene, saath HBr.

blocks.prompt: Nitrobenzene ko zyada darja hararat aur pressure par Ni ke upar hydrogen se reduce karne ka product batayein.
blocks.explanation: Nitro group amino group mein reduce hota, aniline (phenylamine), C6H5NH2, aur paani bante. In sakht halaat mein kaafi hydrogen ho to ring ki bhi hydrogenation ho sakti hai, cyclohexylamine banta.

items: C6H6 + 3H2 -> cyclohexane (Ni, taqreeban 150 C, zyada pressure).
Addition aromatic delocalisation khatam karta, is liye sakht halaat chahiye.
